name: Convivial Enricher Mailchimp
description: Provides integration of Mailchimp API with Enricher.
project_description: Submodule of Convivial Enricher. Provides a 'mailchimp' EnricherDatasource plugin that looks up a Mailchimp list member by unique id (the token from the endpoint URL) using the contrib Mailchimp module's client factory, filters the member's properties and namespaced tags through shell-wildcard allow-lists, and returns the surviving values as cookies. Depends on the contrib Mailchimp module for API credentials and the client.
